summary: The diff clearly updates the attendance stats label to “Average mid-week attendance” and updates attendance-average calculations to treat both legacy “Weekday” and new “Mid-week” records as mid-week. However, the diff does not provide evidence that the Record Attendance modal dropdown option/value was changed (only edit-mode normalization is shown), nor that attendance record cards were updated to display “Mid-week Meeting” instead of “Weekday Meeting”, nor that all remaining user-visible “Weekday” occurrences were swept across the frontend UI.
